 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R 1.
All the States/Union Territories as also the respective High Courts are duly represented.
2. The directions issued in terms of our order dated 13.02.2026 have yet not been complied with.

We direct that some of those States/Union Territories/ High Courts who have not complied with the said directions, shall comply within next seven working days, failing which the Chief Secretary of the concerned States shall be present before the Court on the next date of hearing.
Equally such of those High Courts have not furnished the information, may do so within the very same period, failing which their Registrar Generals shall remain present.

3. Needless to add, the information shall be furnished as per the template, extracted below, which is prepared by the person who is assisting us in this matter :
